text: Figure 9.7: Receive indication interrupt driven Activity Description Receive Interrupt The CAN Controller indicates a successful reception and triggers a receive interrupt. Invalidation of CAN hardware object, provide CPU access to CAN mailbox The CPU ( CanDrv) get exclusive access rights to the CAN mailbox or at least to the corresponding hardware object, where new data were received. Buffering, normalizing The L-PDU is normalized and is buffered in the temporary buffer located in CanDrv. Each CanDrv owns such a temporary buffer for every Physical Channel only if normalizing of the data is necessary .
